purpose: Exact weak-member marginal raw-output diagnostic, plus calibration-excluded-member control. No deployment decision from contaminated H3 calibration.
population: All calibration rows; first 32 calibration shot stems by sha256 for bounded initial diagnostic, all frames of each selected shot. No outcome-based selection.
metrics: shot-bootstrap 2000 seed990 CI95 and probability improvement
interpretation: H3 comparisons exposed to calibration training. Calibration-untrained comparison still checkpoint-selected on calibration; diagnostic, not untouched test. No MAST use. No full composite-score claim.
next: Full finisher attribution on existing held-out D18 models; full H3 ablation requires a frozen public evaluation decision or a newly fitted holdout ensemble.
